ex.en: Seen from a plane, that island is very beautiful.
ex.zh: 從飛機上看，那座島非常美。

ex.en: No one lived on the island at that time.
A massive earthquake of magnitude 8.8 hit the Japanese islands today.
ex.zh: 今天，規模 8.8 的強烈地震侵襲了日本列島。

ex.en: We have issues we have to deal with.
ex.zh: 我們有一些必須處理的問題。

ex.en: This issue has nothing to do with you.
She has dropped out of school due to health issues.
ex.zh: 她因為健康問題休學了。

ex.en: The meteorological bureau has issued a red rainstorm alert.
ex.zh: 氣象局發布了豪雨紅色警報。

ex.en: The magazine is issued twice a month.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌每個月出刊兩次。
